answer: tide admits a lantern only if the admission burns onyx at twice the previous admission's price, read from the live entry count in tide at commit. Ordering is total: entries cannot be batched, split, or reserved ahead, so the nth clone burns 2^(n−1) onyx at the gate — the tenth 512, the fortieth past 5×10^11, a thousand unpayable. The bill is onyx burned per admission, attached to each tide entry. It breaks once onyx is applicant-mintable or a tide entry can transfer.
